title: PerfInput
description: Which of the session's frames' records `perf` reads.

diff_from.description:
The frame of a kept snapshot: answer the diff from it to the
snapshot taken now, or, without `snapshot`, to the newest kept.

max.description: The most records to answer, 1 to 600.

since.description: The first record's number: 0, or the last answer's `next`.

snapshot.description:
Take a heap snapshot now: what holds the heap by memory tag. The
session keeps its last 8, by frame.
